pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Free for civilians and press. Pro for analysts. Custom for enterprise and government.
pricing.tier_free.name: Free
pricing.tier_free.body: Public map, delayed events, basic search, 1 watchlist.
pricing.tier_pro.name: Pro
pricing.tier_pro.body: Realtime, unlimited watchlists, alerts, AI copilot, exports.
pricing.tier_team.name: Team
pricing.tier_team.body: Case files, collaboration, shared dashboards, RBAC.
pricing.tier_ent.name: Enterprise / Gov
pricing.tier_ent.body: SSO, SLA, on-prem option, custom layers.
pricing.note: Pro is free for verified journalists and qualified NGOs.
about.title: About Aegis Lens
about.subtitle: We make conflict, infrastructure and geopolitical events legible — verified, fast, cited.
about.mission.heading: Mission
about.mission.body: Compress the time between an event and verified, actionable intelligence — to under 90 seconds.
about.method.heading: Methodology
about.method.body: Public sources only. Multi-source corroboration. AI assistance with citation. Human-in-the-loop on high-impact events. Public corrections.
about.ethics.heading: Ethics
about.ethics.body: No targeting-grade data. No doxxing. Civilian-safety bias. Independent ethics board.
